site_name: Former National Westminster Bank Sports Ground
application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description: Outline application (appearance reserved only) for the demolition of all existing buildings and structures and redevelopment of the site for a sports led scheme comprising two hockey pitches and three padel courts, with associated floodlighting, cricket pitch, sports hall and pavilion.  The scheme also includes 288 new homes, of which 150 are houses and 138 are apartments and a circa 84 bed care home, within buildings ranging from two to four storeys, car and cycle parking, new local park, pond, playspace, informal recreation, refuse, plant and associated facilities and amenities.
